findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_return_policy, get_price_match_policy, get_merchant_discounts, get_deal, predict_amazon_price, search_blog, get_blog_post, get_credit_card · Private data: search_return_policies, search_discounts, predict_amazon_price, search_credit_cards, get_credit_card, about_thrifle · Public sink: get_price_match_policy, get_blog_post · Destructive: predict_amazon_price.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_return_policy, get_price_match_policy, get_merchant_discounts, get_deal, predict_amazon_price, search_blog, get_blog_post, get_credit_card · Private data: search_return_policies, search_discounts, predict_amazon_price, search_credit_cards, get_credit_card, about_thrifle · Public sink: get_price_match_policy, get_blog_post · Destructive: predict_amazon_price

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
